## ✨ Added

- First release. **[Garage](https://git.deuxfleurs.fr/Deuxfleurs/garage)** (the S3-compatible object store) and **[garage-webui](https://github.com/khairul169/garage-webui)** (its web admin panel) bundled into one container, single-node, running on s6-overlay. Both are the official, unmodified upstream binaries — pulled in via multi-stage `COPY --from=`, no rebuild from source.
- Zero manual CLI setup: single-node cluster layout is created automatically at startup (Garage's own `--single-node` flag, v2.3.0+), and an S3 access key, secret key and bucket are pre-seeded from the template fields on first boot. Garage's own Community Applications listings are split across three separate templates from another maintainer; this template replaces all three with one working, browsable S3 store.
- garage-webui talks to Garage's admin API over `localhost` — buckets, keys and cluster health are all browsable without touching a terminal.
- Ports: 3900 (S3 API), 3902 (S3 website, advanced), 3909 (admin panel). RPC (3901) and the admin API (3903) are intentionally not published.
- CI boot-smoke-test gate: every build boots the container with test credentials and polls both the admin API and the web UI before the multi-arch image is pushed.

## 🎨 Design

- Icon and banner use the official Garage mark from [garagehq.deuxfleurs.fr](https://garagehq.deuxfleurs.fr/), taken as-is.
